controls.label: Shape
controls.description: The shared grid marks unavailable imagery over the original YORP radar reconstruction, shown with prepared lighting. The archived mesh matches the paper’s A-rough best-fit model to its rounded dimensions and volume. Northern observations constrain the shape better than the southern hemisphere. Rotation uses the published 2001-07-27 reference spin rate of 42582.41 degrees/day, held fixed for display; the measured 0.0002 degrees/day² spin acceleration is not extrapolated. This is not a current attitude ephemeris.
controls.title: Radar shape model
controls.summary: Radar shape with stronger coverage in the north. Rotation uses a fixed rate, not a current attitude model.

controls.label: Elevation
controls.description: Color shows the original radar-model radius minus a 0.0564 km reference sphere. It includes the asteroid’s global shape and is not height above a gravitational equipotential or independent measured topography. Colors are transferred from the full source surface to the displayed triangles. About 25% of the model was unseen or observed at high radar incidence; the polar extent is less well constrained. Cartographic relief and optional Sun lighting are display treatments.
controls.title: Shape-derived radial height
controls.summary: Radar height relative to a 56.4 m sphere. A quarter had poor or no coverage; the polar shape is uncertain.
